messages:
Carmen (Growth): Quick sync: finalizing newsletter send for the Benchmark Brief launch. Two asks: set holdback/control group + confirm lead routing for demo clicks. Draft and segmentation here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/benchmark-brief.

Neha (Content): I shortened the launch email to one lead stat + three use cases. Subject tests: 
- A: "Benchmark brief: make inference cheaper and faster"
- B: "How teams cut LLM latency in production"
Also wrote an alternate subject for the 72h resend.

Ethan (Deliverability): ESP notes: set velocity cap to 110k/hr to stay under throttling. Recommend a 5% randomized holdback (no send) for long-term lift measurement. Geo-stagger NA / EMEA / APAC over 48h. Seed test 1k tomorrow 08:30 PT.

Rafael (Sales Ops): For demo clicks we need deterministic routing: any lead who clicks demo and has intent score >60 -> SDR queue #sdr-inbound with tag "benchmark_launch". Low intent clicks -> nurture track. Also exclude any account assigned to an AE currently in active outreach. I can push these rules to the routing service if you confirm event and score thresholds.

Carmen (Growth): Confirmed: demo_click event + intent_score >= 60. Also add UTM params: utm_campaign=benchmark_brief&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email. Measurement window: conversions within 7 days.

Neha (Content): Small ask: can we mention a high-level latency stat in the hero? Legal approved a non-specific number ("up to X% median improvement"). Ill use the phrasing: "median latency improved by up to X% in our tests".

Ethan (Deliverability): Good. Also set early-bounce pause: if bounce rate >1.5% in first 30m, pause and push remainder into a 72h drip with alternate subject. Monitor complaint rate and spamtraps. Ill add alerts to #deliverability.

Rafael (Sales Ops): I'll add the routing rule and test it with the campaign webhook sandbox. ETA: Ill push changes tonight and share test IDs.

Carmen (Growth): Holdback plan: 5% global holdout, plus a 2% internal employee holdback for QA. We'll run analysis at 14 days for lift. Also want a 1% seeded control to validate attribution.

Neha (Content): A/B plan: subjects A/B for main send; alternate subject for 72h resend uses B-alt. Preheaders: benefit-focused vs curiosity. Ill add variants to the doc.

Ethan (Deliverability): Timing: list prep tonight, seed 08:30 PT tomorrow, review 09:30 PT, main send starts Thursday 10:00 PT NA. Ill set burst cap and watch ESP throttles.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "benchmark_brief_newsletter". Reminder set: review meeting tomorrow 09:30 AM PT.

Carmen (Growth): Action items:
- Neha: finalize subjects + 72h resend copy (EOD)
- Ethan: run seed + set alerts (tomorrow AM)
- Rafael: deploy routing rule + share test result (tonight)
- Carmen: finalize holdbacks + analytics plan (today)

Rafael (Sales Ops): Will share webhook dump and a sample routed lead in the thread when done.

Neha (Content): On it :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Deliverability): Ill post seed metrics after run.

Carmen (Growth): Thanks team. If anyone spots a deliverability or routing edge-case ping me directly. :rocket:
